verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global employment and payroll provider, so an end-to-end payroll run flow is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains only a generic marketing line ('Multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies') and API endpoints for retrieving bonuses and allowances. Nothing documents an ops workflow to review hours and earnings, preview payroll totals, and submit a payroll cycle in one flow, so these are adjacent features rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow
